title: The smallest and largest in one call

blocks.text: A method returns one value. To return two, return one object that carries both: since Java 16 a record does it in one line, `record MinMax(int min, int max) {}`.
`Range` gives you that record. Write `of(int[] numbers)` in `Range`. It returns the smallest and the largest value together, as an `Optional<MinMax>`:

items: a single value is both: `of(new int[]{7})` is `MinMax(7, 7)`;
an empty or `null` array has no smallest or largest value: return `Optional.empty()`, not a made-up pair such as `MinMax(Integer.MAX_VALUE, Integer.MIN_VALUE)`.

cases.says: An empty or null array gives Optional.empty().

concepts: A method returns one value, so several results are returned together in a record or another object.
